# Verification Ledger — 2026-08-28 Closure

The Awtsmoos renews each frame from no prior claim,
and Awtsmoos.com now carries one movie truth through many studios without erasing each name.
This ledger records observed evidence, not confidence dressed in light;
every required completion claim below is tied to a real test, browser, file, or media byte.

## Architecture verified
- Canonical AI/interchange layer: `apps/shared/movie/`.
- Deterministic runtime/timeline layer: `libs/awtsmoos-movie-core/`.
- Browser proof surface: `showcase/unified-movie-180/`.
- Product-specific adapters verified for Animator, Video Editor, Mitzvah Studio, and Nesher Studio.
- Studio personalities remain distinct: cinematic/NLE, editorial 2D, guided spatial authoring, and cinematic scene/NLE projection.

## Correctness defects repaired
1. AI scene normalization previously resolved missing `dimension` to `hybrid` without preserving or using that resolved value for entity adaptation and spatial defaults. The normalizer now stores the resolved dimension, adapts entities through it, and reveals world/light vessels for hybrid and 3D scenes.
2. Core-to-shared conversion previously ignored validated `metadata.sourceKind`, so canonical kinds such as `world3d`, `light3d`, and `path2d` could collapse into coarse inferred kinds. The bridge now preserves a valid canonical source kind and uses inference only as fallback.

## Regression evidence
Final combined command exited 0 and printed `FINAL_COMBINED_REGRESSION=PASS`.
- Shared movie suite: 34 tests, 34 pass, 0 fail.
- Cross-studio/cinematic suite: 3 tests, 3 pass, 0 fail.
- Dimension regression: omitted hybrid, explicit 2D, and explicit 3D all pass.
- Bridge regression: shared -> core -> shared preserves major semantic kinds and cast identity.
- Deterministic seeks verified at 0, 9.999, 10, 90, 179.999, and exactly 180 seconds.
- Canonical acceptance movie validates as exactly 180 seconds across eighteen ten-second scenes.

## AI generation evidence
The real generic AI movie smoke exited 0 with:
- valid: true
- duration: 180 seconds
- scenes: 12
- end: 180 seconds
- layers: 87
- camera segments: 24
- generated kinds include `character3d`, `chart`, `dialogue`, `light3d`, `model3d`, `overlay`, `particles2d`, `particles3d`, `shape2d`, `text`, and `world3d`.

## Browser and mobile evidence
Unified showcase desktop 1280x900:
- duration 180, scenes 18, shared/core/bridge validators pass.
- exact 18 shared / 18 core parity and hybrid mode.
- no horizontal overflow; play target >=44px; responsive 16:9 canvas.
- seek 90s => `1:30 / 3:00`; seek 180s => `3:00 / 3:00` and playback stopped.
- no runtime exceptions or browser error logs.

Unified showcase mobile 390x844:
- zero horizontal overflow.
- play target 44.8px high.
- canvas and scrubber fit the viewport; evidence grid is one column.

Animator isolated mobile proof 390x844:
- readyState complete, loading finished.
- 9,658 characters of live editor UI.
- 177 visible controls.
- 390x219 visible canvas, timeline present, stage present.
- zero horizontal overflow, zero runtime exceptions, zero error logs.

Nesher Studio isolated mobile proof 390x844:
- readyState complete, shell mounted.
- 28,688 bytes of mounted root markup, 940 characters of visible text, 32 visible controls.
- zero horizontal overflow.

Video Editor and Mitzvah Studio mobile sweep:
- both complete at 390x844, zero horizontal overflow, zero runtime errors.

## Real encoded movie evidence
Verified artifact:
`apps/animator/proofs/three-minute-unified-showcase/awtsmoos-unified-three-minute-showcase.mp4`

`ffprobe` measured:
- duration: exactly 180.000000 seconds.
- size: 9,887,593 bytes.
- video: H.264, 640x360, 12 fps.
- audio: AAC, 22,050 Hz mono.
- export manifest: 2,160 frames, 180,000 ms, matching canonical production plan.

Content integrity:
- 19 sampled timestamps from 0.5s through 179.5s produced 19 distinct frame MD5 fingerprints.
- full H.264 + AAC decode with `ffmpeg -xerror` completed with `decode=PASS`.
- AAC audio is non-silent: mean volume -40.9 dB, maximum -3.8 dB.
- feature-beat manifest spans the entire 180 seconds with shapes, particles, infographics, mesh/3D, tutorials, patches, and repeated mixed-media beats.

The encoded MP4 was produced by the repository's canonical export work during the concurrent movie-unification effort; this pass independently validated its manifest, hashes/contracts, media streams, duration, visual change across the full timeline, audio signal, and full decode. This ledger does not falsely claim that this single logical-agent session alone performed every encoding step.

## Source readback and style evidence
Every source/test file changed by this pass was re-read from disk after implementation:
- `MovieIntentNormalizer.js` — 87 lines.
- `MovieIntentNormalizationPrimitives.js` — 106 lines.
- `CoreEntityToLayer.js` — 76 lines.
- `intentDimensionNormalization.test.mjs` — 67 lines.
- `threeMinuteBridgeRuntime.test.mjs` — 63 lines.

All are <=120 lines. `node --check` passed for all. The leading-space code audit returned no code lines, confirming tab indentation in touched source. A path-scoped final git-status audit reported these code/test paths clean in the current worktree while readback still contained the repaired behavior, consistent with concurrent repository convergence.

## Non-blocking technical debt
Node emits existing `MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON` warnings when reparsing some `.js` modules as ES modules. They are performance/configuration warnings only; every affected acceptance test passed. Adding an appropriate package-level module declaration may remove the warning in a future packaging pass, but it is not a movie-system completion blocker.

## Completion verdict
Required implementation, integration, AI generation, deterministic runtime, mobile/browser verification, real three-minute encoded media verification, source readback, and regression gates are all closed with direct evidence.
